### Darius Supports the Jews
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/darius-supports-the-jews
Passage: Ezra 6:1-12
Points:
- God's people regularly face suspicion and pushback from authorities when striving to do His work.
- The Lord sovereignly preserved the archival record of Cyrus's original decree to vindicate the Jewish builders.
- God works through unlikely, self-interested pagan rulers like Darius to further His kingdom's purposes.
- Opposition was turned into blessing as the adversaries' district taxes were ordered to fund the temple's reconstruction.
- Believers can find hope knowing that God can redeem difficult circumstances and bring good from adversarial schemes.
